deviations.claim_in_article: Mark Zuckerberg himself made some of the calls.
deviations.issue: The Ledger reports that trained human contract staff handled some Muse calls; it does not say Zuckerberg made calls. The article substitutes a specific, unsupported actor for the reported callers.
deviations.explanation: This adds an unsupported claim about who made the calls and changes the reported actor from trained contract staff to Zuckerberg.
